motion_rule: a cheap grey fish plays supermodel. She moves across frame, never into depth; the ice slides so every pose overshoots. Shot size changes every beat exactly as written in c
character: a plain grey-blue mackerel, dull unblinking eye, chin high, tiny pectoral fin
second_characters: a blue glove from above twice, never looking at her; a salmon head in the next tray, its own spine already bare
props: ONE price tag with big sharp digits that jump three times; A SWARM of crushed ice
prop_continuity: the tag is in frame from 0.00 and its digits jump at 1.75, 5.25 and 9.30
environment: a bright fish counter at noon, white tile and steel trays, roof glass
light_events: hard noon glare off wet ice, bright flashes on her scales each pose

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: smug oily female voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word, 4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: pro-SHLI, vre-me-NA, lo-so-SYA, te-PER, mo-YA, O-che-red, blis-TAT, KAZH-doy, KOS-toch-ke
audio.pacing: 0.55-2.45, 3.05-5.25 and 6.55-8.70 each one breath; after 8.70 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her jaw drops wide and her lips shape every syllable, gills flaring, never a voice over
audio.sfx: market hum, ice trickling, the tag clicking three times

timeline.a: a heap of identical grey mackerel settles and one rears up on her tail, same dull eye as the rest
she sucks her gills in and throws her chest out, goods turning into a diva
she shoves off, overshoots her mark and freezes chin up as if she meant it
her tail knocks the price tag round so its digits face the lens and jump
the recoil carries her a body length past the salmon head, whose own spine is already bare; she does not look
a slower pass with her tiny pectoral fin held out in front
she jabs the fin at herself, cannot reach, bends her whole body into an arc
she holds the arc, shuddering with effort, glare flashing off her flank
she rolls her side flat to the roof glass and it flares white
the digits jump again; she takes it for applause and arches harder
a blue glove tips a shovel of ice over her from above, burying her to mid body, and leaves
she walks the runway while buried, shoving off and not moving at all
she bursts up out of the ice
she lands flat on her side and snaps her chin up as if it were choreography
she starts a grand turn to profile, tail pushing the ice
the ice slides out, the turn carries her half a turn too far and her cut side swings into the lens and fills the frame: clean pink fillet, bare white spine
she holds the star pose, chin up, not seeing it, while the glove slaps the tag onto her bare ribs and the digits jump

must_appear: she rises from a heap of identical fish; the digits jump three times; at 8.70 her cut side turns into the lens: a clean supermarket fillet and bare white spine, goods on a shelf, no wound; she never sees it
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, blood, a wound, torn flesh, red raw meat, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a closed mouth while speaking, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, words, extra tails
